title: Bug triage
audience: For small teams and solo developers without a full issue tracker.
description: A bug triage table. Paste a report or an issue and your AI files it by severity, with the steps to reproduce.
tagline: Every bug in one table, with its severity.
note:
Bug triage

Every bug report in one table, with how much it hurts. Paste a report into your AI and it files it.

## Bugs
<!-- pane-table: Bug=text; Severity=choice P0|P1|P2|P3; Area=text; Status=choice New|Confirmed|In progress|Fixed|Won't fix; Reported=text; Link=text -->
| Bug | Severity | Area | Status | Reported | Link |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Severity
- **P0:** data loss, a security hole, or everyone is blocked. Drop everything.
- **P1:** a main flow is broken for many people. This week.
- **P2:** broken, but there's a workaround. Schedule it.
- **P3:** polish. When there's time.

## Details
Steps to reproduce, what was expected and what happened. One section per bug.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Bug triage". Read it with fetch before each change. When I paste a bug report, file it: follow the rules under "Severity" and add one row to the table with edit, with a short Bug title, Severity by those rules, the Area, Status New, Reported as today's date, and the Link if there is one. Keep the rows sorted by severity, worst first. If the report says how to reproduce it, add a section under "Details" with edit: a "###" heading with the bug title, the steps, what was expected and what happened. To change a status, edit that row.
prompt.claudeCode: Use my Pinto Notes note "Bug triage". Read it with fetch before each change. When I paste a bug report or a GitHub issue (read it with gh issue view), file it: follow the rules under "Severity", add one row to the table with edit (a short Bug title, Severity, Area, Status New, Reported as today's date, Link), then look through this codebase for the likely cause and add the steps to reproduce and the files involved under "Details" with edit, under a "###" heading with the bug title. When we fix one, set its Status to Fixed.

asks: Ask me for the customer's report, then triage it and file it in the table.
